summary.name: Show Desktop
summary.one_liner: Show Desktop is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app that hides every window with one click or a keyboard shortcut (default ⌃⇧D) and restores them afterward.
use_cases: Quickly clear the screen to reach desktop files
Hide all windows and bring them back exactly as they were
Get Windows+D style desktop toggling on a Mac
Hide every app without quitting them
Set a custom shortcut for showing the desktop
summary.what_it_does: Show Desktop lives in the menu bar and hides every window, including the frontmost app and Finder windows, with one click or a shortcut. Pressing the shortcut or clicking again brings everything back. It hides apps the same way as ⌘H, so they keep running with unsaved work intact, and apps that were already hidden stay hidden. The shortcut can be changed via right-click on the menu bar icon, Keyboard Shortcut → Record Shortcut. The page says it runs in the macOS App Sandbox with no network or file access and is open source.
notable: Windows+D equivalent: ⌃⇧D toggles hide and restore
Hides apps like ⌘H without quitting them
Runs in the macOS App Sandbox with no network or file access
Custom shortcut recording via menu bar right-click
caveats: Shortcuts that conflict with typing or existing macOS shortcuts (e.g. ⇧⌘3) are not accepted
